receiptSemantics.guardMeaning: Each W control proves that a failed durable write exits nonzero and emits no success marker; it has no finalization receipt and therefore no applicable pin-coverage verdict.

shapes.P: intact; the harness succeeds with no integrity difference
shapes.C: a pinned file changes while the stage succeeds; rejected with the integrity difference
shapes.Q: the same change plus an ordinary stage failure; rejected with both recorded
shapes.S: a pinned file is missing at snapshot time; rejected with a durable result written
shapes.M: an exception is raised inside the integrity step (pinned file deleted) while the stage fails; the original stage error is still recorded
shapes.X: the owned-process call itself throws after the evidence directory exists
shapes.R: an owned carrier is left dirty while the stage fails; the carrier check still runs
shapes.F: the child stage fails (exit 7) with every pin intact; the durable verdict is fail
shapes.T: the child stage outlives a real short owned deadline; the durable verdict is fail and the helper records the timeout
shapes.W: the durable result path is a directory, so the durable write fails; the run exits nonzero with no success marker
shapes.U: an exception is raised inside cleanup/restoration (not the integrity step) while the stage fails; stage, cleanup and integrity results are all recorded
shapes.E: the pinned validator executable is missing; the check runs inside the evidence region and the durable result records it
shapes.L: a labelled entry pin changes; entry values appear only under entry* keys and the plain key holds the post-run pin
shapes.G: a git double fails or hangs during finalization; the owned git call records exit, stderr or timeout as an integrity error

textSemantics: Missing-file witnesses use the substring find, common to the .NET and PowerShell 5.1/7 not-found messages. Each stage/integrity entry is a list of groups; every group must be matched by one string value of the durable result (all substrings of the group inside that single value). Values under a pinChecks property are excluded. stageValue is an alternative stage witness: a property with that name and numeric value anywhere in the durable result. V1 fields: pinRosters independently specify each harness's ordered pinCheck identities and expected captured indexes by expect.pinStage; controls without pinStage use complete. Static repository-relative rows compare as exact Windows path identities. fixture:, shell:, toolchain:, and history: rows are resolved by the production parent from its trusted fixture root, child/host shell roles, registry-pinned toolchain directory, and the pinned copied RESULTS.json input before child execution; broad suffix and basename-regex rules are unsupported. Slash/case aliases of the same Windows path compare canonically. Historical expect.capturedPins values are retained as v2 metadata but v3 coverage is roster-driven. R4 fields: expect.verdict is the exact finalization.verdict; expect.exitCode the exact process exit; expect.values exact typed values (repair-r4/predicates.ps1 Test-R4Values); expect.cleanup groups over the durable values and, structurally, over finalization.cleanupErrors; expect.labels entry-label predicates (Test-R4Labels); expect.durableAbsent/stderr/absentFiles/stdoutAbsent the durable-write-failure surface; expect.pins=all-verified requires every captured pin verified. Exactly 57 controls have durable finalization receipts; K1-W, K2-W and LV-W are guarded no-receipt controls whose pin coverage is explicitly not applicable. Control fields: faultTarget and removePath override the recipe target/remove path; gitDouble prepends the R4 git double to PATH. baseExpectation timeout means the base harness does not finish before the control deadline.

An exclusive lock held until process exit makes the fixture restoration throw inside cleanup while the stage fails: stage error, cleanup error and all 7 verified pins plus the tree check are recorded (audit P3-2 (a)). R3 already handles this path, so d27ffa34 is expected to accept.

A labelled pin (the copied integrity_controls source) changes during a passing stage: its entry value must appear only under entrySource and source must hold the changed post-run pin (audit P3-5).

A git double on PATH hangs once the stage has run: the final HEAD read must time out under the owned 60 s deadline and be recorded as an integrity error (audit P3-7); d27ffa34 hangs until the control deadline.
A git double on PATH fails every call once the capture completes: the finalization carrier/fixture status must record the exit and stderr as integrity errors (audit P3-7).
